alt: The latest HackerNews stories and their comment threads come in from the Algolia HN API; an LLM call through litellm turns each message into normalized topics ("books for autistic kids" becomes book, autistic and autistic kids), the topics are stored in the hn_topics and hn_messages tables in Postgres, and python main.py prints a ranked list of trending topics; a new story adds only its own rows.
needs: GEMINI_API_KEY (or LLM_MODEL with its provider key)

run.note: Fetch the latest threads and extract topics
